task.title: Wire restricted reentrant enrollment and final one-time confirmation
task.input: M3-T19 real restricted sessions; section 09/10 pending/confirm states and current TOTP CAS.
task.output: POST /api/auth-admin/recovery/enroll and POST /api/auth-admin/recovery/confirm; reentry and atomic publication of the new factor.
task.accept: 1) Caller/wiring point: real restricted handlers -> recovery-enrollment service. Encrypt pendingSecret on first entry; reentry within the original window returns the same URI/original expiresAt without rotation or extension. Wrong/expired/repeated confirms and two concurrent confirms check current token/sv/secret/step and commit at most once. The old valid method remains usable before a failing attempt (E-08, E-14). 2) After a real confirm with a new unused TOTP, publish secret/new recovery-code hashes, increment sv, revoke old devices/recovery credentials, consume the session, and clear the cookie in one transaction. Return recovery codes once. Change password simultaneously only for a SERVER_OWNER-preauthorized hash; HTTP accepts only totp. Unknown outcomes do not replay; actual ordinary sign-in at the next time step verifies the result. Old factors/devices reject (E-15).
